text: Developer API exposes meeting transcripts and structured notes via standard REST calls
quote: The Developer API opens that data to you: transcripts, structured notes, and more, all available through standard REST calls.

text: API requests are authenticated with an API key in the Authorization header
quote: All API requests must include a valid API key in the Authorization header.

text: Webhooks deliver real-time notifications when events occur in Fellow
quote: Webhooks allow you to receive real-time notifications when events occur in Fellow.

text: API can list meeting recordings with filters and pagination
quote: List recordings with optional filters and pagination.

text: API can list action items with filters and pagination
quote: List action items with optional filters and pagination.

text: API can append content to the end of a note's agenda without overwriting existing content
quote: Add Fellow Markdown to the end of a note's agenda, leaving the rest of the content in place.

text: Super Admin API keys can act on behalf of any user in the workspace via a header
quote: Super Admin API keys can make requests on behalf of any user in the workspace using the `X-On-Behalf-Of` header.

text: Users can ask natural-language questions about their meetings, like what action items were assigned this week
quote: Ask anything about your meetings - Get answers to questions like "What were my action items this week?" or "What did we decide in last month's standup?"

text: MCP Connector works with any AI tool that supports connectors, avoiding platform lock-in
quote: Fellow’s MCP Connector works with any AI tool that supports connectors, so you're never locked into one platform

text: Workspace admins can control which MCP tools members' AI assistants are allowed to use
quote: As a workspace admin, you decide which MCP tools your members’ AI assistants can use.

text: Meetings can be recorded with a visible bot or bot-free by capturing audio from the desktop, across Zoom, Meet, Teams, Slack Huddles, and in-person meetings
quote: Fellow gives teams the flexibility to record with a visible bot or without one — capturing audio directly from the desktop across Zoom, Google Meet, Microsoft Teams, Slack Huddles, and in-person meetings

text: Org-wide policies can be set governing how meetings are recorded, accessed, and retained
quote: Set organization-wide policies for how meetings are recorded, accessed, and retained

text: Keyword tracking across meetings
quote: Keyword tracking

text: Super Admin API allows Enterprise admins to retrieve, export, and delete data across the entire workspace
quote: Fellow’s Super Admin API lets designated Enterprise‑plan administrators retrieve, export, and delete data across the entire workspace

text: Some API requests are authenticated via an X-API-KEY header
quote: Include your API key in the `X-API-KEY` header of every request

text: Users can generate new named API keys for their applications
quote: Generate a new API key for your application, giving it a descriptive name.

text: MCP Server lets an AI Assistant answer questions about meetings without writing any code
quote: Fellow's Model Context Protocol (MCP) Server allows you to ask your AI Assistant about your meetings, without needing to write any code.

text: Action items can be filtered to show only those assigned to the current user versus teammates
quote: assigned_to_me: Only action items assigned to the authenticated user\n- assigned_to_others: Only action items the user can edit, assigned to teammates

text: Every meeting produces a full transcript that is searchable for instant access to past context
quote: Every conversation becomes searchable through a full transcript, giving your team instant access to past context whenever they need it.

text: Transcripts can be redacted
quote: Transcript redaction

text: Meetings automatically generate a summary, AI-suggested action items, decisions, and topic-based minutes
quote: You automatically receive a clear meeting summary, suggested AI action items, decisions, and topic-based minutes for every meeting.

text: Admin dashboards can be built to display data from a specific user's perspective
quote: Build admin dashboards that display data from a specific user's perspective

text: AI chatbots like Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor can directly access meeting recaps, notes, and action items
quote: Your favorite AI chatbot like Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor can now tap directly into your meeting recaps, notes, and action items

text: Users can pause or resume recording to keep parts of a conversation off the record
quote: Users choose when to record, pause, or resume capture when part of a conversation needs to stay off the record.

text: Configurable data retention policies can be set, including zero-day retention
quote: Set configurable retention policies, including zero-day retention, so data is handled according to your organization’s requirements.

text: Transcripts can be passed to an LLM through the API for tailored recaps and action plans
quote: pass transcripts to an LLM for tailored recaps and action plans, the API gives you everything you need to make it happen
